title: Retell in the present
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Ali Baba and the forty thieves; occasions
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: retell in the present)
intro: Lesson 11: Present-tense verbs in the story. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

box.title: Five lines of the story in the present tense. Underline the يَـ or تَـ in each verb.

questions.q: Change to the present: خَرَجَ قَاسِمٌ.
Retell five lines of the story in the present tense on the pupil PDF, then underline the يَـ or تَـ in each verb.
questions.a: يَذْهَبُ عَلِي بَابَا إِلَى الغَابَةِ. يَرَى أَرْبَعِينَ لِصًّا. يَقُولُ الرَّئِيسُ ... يَدْخُلُ اللُّصُوصُ. يَخْرُجُ قَاسِمٌ.

questions.q: Extend: write two sentences about a girl in the present (تَـ).
questions.a: For example: تَقْرَأُ مَرْيَمُ القِصَّةَ. تَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ.

questions.q: Stretch: what is the present of رَأَى?
Think again: why switch to the present?
questions.a: To make it feel like it is happening now.
